hospitalName.title: Hospital / Clinic Name
hospitalName.description: Facility for the visit — used as calendar Event location.

notes.title: Objective / Notes
notes.description: What the rep plans to discuss — product, key ask, follow-up from previous visit.

physicianName.title: Physician Name
physicianName.description: Doctor to visit (e.g. 'Dr. Gupta'). Use the name from the current session if not restated.

preferredDate.title: Preferred Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
preferredDate.description: Date for the visit. Parse from rep's words: 'kal' = tomorrow, 'agle hafte' = 7 days, 'agle Monday' = next Monday, 'agle mahine' = 30 days. Format as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave blank to default to 3 working days from today.

preferredTime.title: Preferred Time (HH:MM 24-hour)
preferredTime.description: Start time. Parse: '10 baje' = '10:00', 'dopahar 2' = '14:00', 'shaam 5' = '17:00'. Leave blank to default to 10:00.
